title: Among users who obtained both 'Teacher' and 'Supporter' badges and reside i
question: Among users who obtained both 'Teacher' and 'Supporter' badges and reside in New York, find the display name of the owner of the highest-scoring child post (i.e., a post with a non-null ParentId) created by any of these users.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
WHERE u.XCL_058 = 'New York'
  AND p.XCL_040 IS NOT NULL
  AND u.XCL_052 IN (
    SELECT b.XCL_002
    FROM badges b
    WHERE b.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
  )
  AND u.XCL_052 IN (
    SELECT b.XCL_002
    FROM badges b
    WHERE b.XCL_003 = 'Supporter'
  )
ORDER BY p.XCL_031 DESC
LIMIT 1;
